releaseNotes:
Cedar 1.0.0 Early beta starts a fresh beta line that replaces 1.4.1.

- A new look for Settings, Explore, Library, Sources and detail pages, matching Apple TV.
- Viewing Stats (Experimental).
- Live TV Branches and Follow people on Home.
- When Resuming: Ask, Always Resume or Always Start Over.
- Arrange player controls, Picture adjustments (Experimental) and Reuse Last Link.
- Fixes for holding Select, Up Next jumping early, and server-only episodes.
